plugin.name: Condemned Fusion Fix
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view; larger is wider, up to 150 degrees across. Scripted cameras and zoomed views keep their own.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the native fix menu language. Auto uses a supported detected language, or English when detection or translation is unavailable. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changes.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, windowed or borderless. Needs a restart; no autoexec.cfg change is needed.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't slip onto another monitor. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the game's bars above and below cinematics; Pillarbox keeps the picture at 16:9 between side bars on wider screens; Both does both; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keeps the game's fade of the cinematic bars. Off shows and hides them at once.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Applies immediately.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Needs a restart.
